name: RuneScape Wiki MCP
subtitle: RS3 prices, trends and wiki
summary: Ask your assistant about RuneScape 3 guide prices, item trends, flip estimates, normal-mode hiscores and wiki pages.
description: A read-only RuneScape 3 helper for chat. Look up items by name, compare Grand Exchange guide prices, summarize 7–90 days of price history, estimate flip profit after the 2% seller tax, check normal-mode player hiscores, and read RuneScape Wiki pages. Connect the hosted MCP endpoint without an account, API key or local installation. Prices come from Jagex guide data and Weirdgloop daily history; they lag the live market. RS3 only: Old School RuneScape, live bid/ask quotes, automated trading, and ironman/hardcore hiscores are not supported. An unofficial community project, unaffiliated with Jagex or the RuneScape Wiki.
starterPrompts: What is the RS3 guide price of an Abyssal whip?
Compare Dragon bones and Frost dragon bones over the past 30 days.
Estimate profit on 10 Dragon bones bought for 100 coins and sold for 120 coins each.
